Pinebridge Investments Lp bought 32,950 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.05% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 38,187 shares of the in vitro & in vivo diagnostic substances company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $535,000, up from 5,237 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pinebridge Investments Lp who had been investing in Meridian Bioscience Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $626.70M market cap company. (NASDAQ:VIVO) has risen 7.87% since May 28, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.68% the S&P500.
